risk_note: RV1 identity plus app.module: a console phone change on a flagged account unbinds every third-party identity outside the trusted snapshot, clears the flag and count, sets last_active_at to now (D10-584, Jev 0.78), keeps re-verified devices, in the same transaction. An unbound Apple identity gets a revocation job in that transaction carrying only the stored cipher; the worker revokes after commit, three tries, then one warn, never rolling back. The audit records unbound_providers and reverify_cleared. Frozen integration: spec/identity 2140 pass, 0 fail, before the last test-only commit; reverify-clear 52 pass after it.
